description: This file contains a final class 'ImmutableTopicPathBuilder' implementing multiple builder interfaces for constructing TopicPath instances in a thread-unsafe manner. It includes static factory methods, builder pattern methods for setting properties (group, criterion, action, etc.), and an inner class for an empty TopicPath.

classes.name: ImmutableTopicPathBuilder
classes.description: A final class that implements multiple builder interfaces for constructing TopicPath objects.

classes.name: ImmutableTopicPathBuilder.EmptyTopicPath
classes.description: A static inner class implementing a singleton pattern for an immutable empty TopicPath.

methods.description: Returns an empty TopicPath instance.
